svg.text: One app window, one process per bot, one agent per call. Every solid box is its own process: its own memory, its own crash.
The one window you see. It owns the bots.
the selected bot's real panel, relayed
where agents and skills find bots
spawns bots, sees every exit, reads output
test fleet, or started by hand
Still a bot process, but not the app's child. The app finds it by scanning
ports and stops it over HTTP.
spawns each bot as its own child
one per bot in a call
Claude Code · opened by its bot
A bot that crashes takes nothing else down. The app sees the exit and its reason; if the app goes away, its bots finish their calls and quit.
